summary: Comprehensive CMS testing for Culture Connect 2026. Tested CMS Admin login, Programme editor with 4 days, Day 3 Abolition highlighting, Design section with color pickers/fonts, Pages section for dynamic pages, public /programme page, and /p/:slug dynamic routes. All 9 features verified working.

cms_admin_login: Dashboard shows all CMS tabs (Médias, Profils, Intervenants, Partenaires, Design, Contenu, Pages, Aperçu)
cms_contenu_section: Contenu tab accessible with Programme, Accueil, À propos sub-tabs
Programme editor shows 4 days with expand/collapse
Each day displays label, site, and slots count
Day 3 (Abolition) has terracotta highlighting and 'JOURNÉE SPÉCIALE' badge
Slots editor with time, title, description, speaker fields
cms_design_section: 5 color pickers available: Couleur principale (#A65D47), Secondaire (#C8922A), Accent (#4A5D4E), Fond (#1A1A1A), Texte (#F4F1EA)
Font selector with 5 options: Inter, Poppins, DM Sans, Montserrat, Source Sans Pro
Section Hero editor with image upload, title, and subtitle
cms_pages_section: Page creation modal with Title, Slug, Meta description, Content (HTML), Publier checkbox
public_programme_page: Displays all 4 days with data-testid attributes
Day 3 highlighted with terracotta background color
All days show time slots with title, description, speaker
dynamic_page_route: Created test page via API successfully
backend_api_tests: GET /api/public/content/program - returns 4 days with Day 3 highlighted

seed_data_creation: Test page created and deleted via API for /p/:slug route verification
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS fully functional. Admin at /admin/cms with password CC2026admin. Programme editor has 4 days with Day 3 (Abolition) highlighted in terracotta #A65D47. Public /programme page displays program from CMS. Dynamic pages accessible via /p/{slug}. Design section has 5 color pickers and 5 font options. All test-created data was cleaned up.
